newsitem.title: USA: Frank Gifford says marriage in good shape.
newsitem.headline: Frank Gifford says marriage in good shape.

text.p: ABC News sportcaster Frank Gifford, whose alleged hotel room encounter with another woman was videotaped by a tabloid newspaper, said Tuesday his marriage to Kathy Lee Gifford remains solid.
Gifford was attending an ABC network affiliates meeting at Walt Disney World. As he left the convention hall, the was asked by a reporter how his marriage was doing.
Smiling, Gifford replied, "It's good. It's solid," and jumped into a waiting van.

The Gifford's marriage has been the target of speculation since The Globe supermarket tabloid began publishing photographs and audio-tape transcripts of Frank Gifford's alleged tryst with a Florida woman in a New York hotel.

In his first public appearance since the story broke, Gifford made no reference to any marital woes as he and broadcast-booth partners Al Michaels and Dan Dierdorf briefed local television affiliates about the coming football season.
The Globe published photographs it claimed showed Gifford in various embraces with Suzen Johnson, a 46-year-old flight attendant, and published transcripts of their alleged conversations.
According to The Globe, Gifford made a May 2 phone call to Johnson, leaving her a message saying he would be in Florida in June on business and hoped to see her then.
Gifford, 66, is twice divorced. Kathy Lee Gifford, 43, is once divorced.
Kathy Lee Gifford is co-host of Live with Regis and Kathy Lee, a syndicated morning talk show.
Orlando Sentinel columnist Leslie Doolittle said ABC News broadcaster Barbara Walters had told her the Giffords and their two children were staying at a Disney resort during the meeting.
